metadata.description: Country-year total population panel for testing how well Benford's law describes the leading digits of national populations: the UN World Population Prospects 2024 estimates 1950-2023 (via the OWID grapher population-with-un-projections), one example per entity-year. Rows carry the published value plus the per-row digit encodings and the pre-registered even/odd year fold. No derived digit statistics are stored: every statistic is computed by the notebook.
metadata.subset_note: DEMO SUBSET SCHEMA. The full panel is kept (all 237 primary entities, 1950-2023, 17,538 rows) because the artifact's thesis is that the effective sample size is the COUNTRY COUNT, not the row count: sub-sampling countries destroys the effect being demonstrated. What is trimmed is the per-row metadata: only the fields the analysis and the integrity gate read are retained, which takes the file from 22 MB to 9 MB. The World Bank WDI companion panel is not included, so the source-invariance stage is skipped.
